messages:
ashley: Quick heads-up — starting a rotational access review for the infra-admins & high-priv svcaccts. Goal: remove long-unused admin grants and verify owners. Kickoff checklist below. Ping me to join the remediation squad.

mike: Timeline? I can run the KMS grant queries + ephemeral key sweep. Need clarity on audit-log retention window.

kiran: Proposed timeline: 7d discovery, 3d owner outreach, 7d removals. @mike use the audit-log query in the ops runbook (https://docs.internal/redwood/ops/audit-queries) and post results.

leo: I'll run KMS discovery. Query I'll run:
```
SELECT key_id, grantee, last_used_ts
FROM kms_grants
WHERE last_used_ts < '2024-06-01'
ORDER BY last_used_ts;
```
Will check cross-account grants as well.

mike: Thanks. For ephemeral keys we should run a rotation check: `rclone ls s3://audit-exports/keys/ | grep ephemeral` — will paste output here after run.

audit-bot: Automated scan complete — found 12 infra-admin principals with no activity in 420+ days; 3 svcaccts missing owner. Report: /internal/reports/access-rotations/3742008765

ashley: For ownerless svcaccts, follow runbook step 4: add temp owners or mark for deactivation. I'll create remediation tickets in JIRA.

kiran: Quick question re: KMS cross-account grants — if we remove a grant, could downstream pipelines break? Suggest a canary removal policy: remove one grant, monitor 24h, rollback on error spikes.

leo: +1 on canary. I'll coordinate with ci-team to watch pipeline metrics. What's our alert SLI for errors? default 5xx rate < 0.1%?

mike: Also enable detailed audit for KMS ops during the sweep: `kms.enable_detailed_audit = true` in feature flags.

ashley: Agreed. Toggling the flag for infra region now. Creating shared tracker: https://docs.internal/redwood/access-rotations/3742008765

kiran: Reminder: log any temporary elevations (who, why, expiry). We'll need that for the post-mortem.

leo: I'll run discovery tonight (22:00 PT) and drop CSV here.

mike: 👍 will schedule a 10m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to hand off.

ashley: Thanks — if anyone finds blockers (legacy certs, metadata gaps) call them out here. /me will follow up with tickets.

audit-bot: Ticket created: JIRA-ACCESS-4821 for 'ownerless svcacct triage' assigned to ashley. ETA: 14d.

kiran: Quick SCIM check snippet for owner lookup:
`curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' "https://scim.internal/users?filter=serviceAccountId eq \"$svcacct\""`

leo: CSV uploaded: /internal/temp/infra-admins-discovery-3742008765.csv

ashley: Closing kickoff — status updates in #eng-security daily at 16:00 PT.
